question: Where can I get a list of data centers in operation in France, with location, operator and capacity (IT power in MW or floor area)?

answer.summary: No public national registry lists operating data centers in France. EU EED Art. 12 and French L. 236-1 / SDES (471 sites) / ARCEP publish aggregates only. Officially, Institut Paris Région's open GIS API covers 149 active Île-de-France sites with coordinates, operator, grid-MW class, and IT/building m², while EDF publishes 2 corporate sites on data.gouv.fr. Nationwide, DCmag (307 neutral sites), uMap/OSM (354 sites), and PeeringDB offer open locations and operators with partial or no capacity, alongside gated/paid directories (Baxtel 243 sites, GuideDC login DB, and blocked Data Center Map).
main_caveats: EU EED 2023/1791 Art. 12(3) and ecologie.gouv.fr restrict the European Data Centre Database to aggregated statistics; SDES's 471-DC inventory and ARCEP's ~160-DC survey publish aggregates only.

Institut Paris Région's official FeatureServer covers only Île-de-France (149 active out of 209 total; ~1/3 of French sites), and its 'puiss_mw_classe' field measures electrical connection capacity bins rather than IT load.

DRIEAT Île-de-France's data.gouv.fr mirror (6a1f7068092c5d59f2777f04) has broken Atom ('Accès non autorisé') and WFS endpoints; Institut Paris Région's geoweb.iau-idf.fr FeatureServer is the working official feed.

Nationwide non-official maps (DCmag 307 sites, PeeringDB) exclude private corporate/public sites such as EDF or banks, and DCmag exposes capacity only on individual copyrighted HTML pages rather than its bulk REST endpoint.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified across French ministries (ecologie.gouv.fr, DGE, SDES), regulator (ARCEP), regional portals (IPR, PACA/AURA/HdF), data.gouv.fr, EU EED legal texts, non-official APIs, and unstructured ICPE/EIA records.
